assessment: The accepted product packet was small, exact and fully deterministic. Eleven reruns came from manually supplied interface details rather than product semantics: module invocation form, a repeated Git object in prose, a copied schema vocabulary, a guessed test path, a descriptive Continuity node kind outside its closed vocabulary, a nominally valid kind whose hidden contract inheritance did not fit the packet, an unsupported register flag, missing required timestamps in two human evidence documents, an invalid rollback argument and an incorrectly reconstructed timestamp-parser slice. The two postpublication timestamp defects required two byte-exact rollbacks. Safety was strong because every lapse was contained before durable acceptance; ergonomics remain weaker because the operator could still express facts, classifications, validators and command shapes that the repository already knows or can compute.
